name: Skylab SL-2
about: Skylab SL-2 (1973-032A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1973 May 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1973 Jun  4), held fixed
